title: Polynomial space is contained in nondeterministic polynomial space
statement: Every language decidable by a deterministic finite Turing machine using at most $c(n^d+1)$ work-tape cells, for some natural numbers $c,d$, is also decidable by a nondeterministic finite Turing machine using at most $C(n^D+1)$ work-tape cells, for some natural numbers $C,D$. The nondeterministic machine halts within some finite number of steps on every branch for each input.
